title: RISE Live: the room's native engines at parity with the Reader's
acceptance: Klee: the Reader's Klee Lines (src/core/visual-registry.js, labelled Genesis; DEDICATED_MODE klee -> genesis) is the room's Genesis, so it is not a second engine; the reader's words 'klee' and 'klee lines' show Genesis at once, and 'chaotic klee' Genesis with that preset.

Night streaks: the Reader draws them only under the attractor (Chamber.js `streaks: true`; visual-catalog.js attractor.streaks), so the room takes them as the attractor's start-only parameter streaks (none|night), lowered to `streaks: true`; 'none' takes away streaks a theme would have drawn. 'night streaks', 'streaks' and 'night attractor' show them at once.

Frames: the attractor with night streaks under it takes the full frame (the streaks are drawn off the centre line, which the shell's circle clips); the visual is still named the attractor, so the catalog word's note clears as for any engine.

The host's guide (Composer, under connector review) is not taught streaks (HOST_WITHHELD_PARAMETERS); Live's instructions and admission take it, as with trace and pendulums. SCENE_ENGINES, the MCP tool's engine enum and the Composer's engine set are unchanged.
Visual Lab recipes as named presets: investigated, no code; the path and the owner's decisions are in the PR description.
